newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 262 OF OCTOBER 16, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 262 OF OCTOBER 16, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Corrigendum to Council Directive 96/48/EC of 23 July 1996 on the interoperability of the trans-European high-speed rail system (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 235 of 17 September 1996)

COMMISSION DECISION of 2 October 1996 amending Decision 92/452/EEC establishing lists of embryo collection teams and embryo production teams approved in third countries for export of bovine embryos to the Community (Text with EEA relevance) (96/596/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1979/96 of 15 October 1996 fixing the export refunds on eggs
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1978/96 of 15 October 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1977/96 of 15 October 1996 fixing the export refunds on poultrymeat
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1976/96 of 15 October 1996 fixing the rates of the refunds applicable to eggs and egg yolks exported in the form of goods not covered by Annex II to the Treaty
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1975/96 of 15 October 1996 fixing the import duties in the cereals sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1974/96 of 15 October 1996 amending Regulation (EC) No 716/96 adopting exceptional support measures for the beef market in the United Kingdom
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1973/96 of 14 October 1996 concerning the stopping of fishing for anglerfish by vessels flying the flag of the Netherlands END OF DOCUMENT.
